chunks: And Hishām ibn al-Ḥakam has narrated from Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام:

There is another reason for that, and it is that when the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was taken on the night journey to the heaven, he passed through seven veils, and at each veil he pronounced one takbīrah. Thus Allah, Mighty and Majestic, brought him by that to the utmost limit of honor.

key_terms.أُسْرِيَ: was taken on the night journey

ai.seo_question: What is the reason for the seven takbirs in prayer according to Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives another reason for the seven takbirs in salat by connecting them to the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم heavenly ascension. It presents each takbir as corresponding to one of the seven veils through which he passed until Allah عز وجل brought him to the highest degree of honor.
